calibration_status: URDF mounting poses; uncalibrated simulation pinhole intrinsics
note: Device models confirmed by user. Real K/distortion, depth noise and RGB-depth baseline are not calibrated.

left_wrist_d405.optical_roll_source: CAD: the D405's rear M3 pair, parallel to its stereo baseline, runs along the jaw axis; image right along the jaw axis, image up outboard. The user confirmed the fingers appear left and right on the real robot (2026-10-24).
left_wrist_d405.mount_source: On the tilted wrist block (hardware/wrist_d405_mount, user decision 2026-10-24): the URDF sensor site carried onto the block by sim/wrist_mount.py, 20 degrees toward the jaws.

right_wrist_d405.optical_roll_source: Mirror of the left wrist: image right along the jaw axis, image up outboard (see left_wrist_d405).
right_wrist_d405.mount_source: On the tilted wrist block (hardware/wrist_d405_mount, user decision 2026-10-24): the URDF sensor site carried onto the block by sim/wrist_mount.py, 20 degrees toward the jaws.
